scope: Direct offline verify_attempt and timing_report integration with fixed invented source bytes, science/RNG objects and a fabricated 20-cell evidence bundle. No evaluator execution or historical source import.

finite_cases.case: Verify one complete fabricated 20-cell bundle and exact file inventory, preserving all candidate/reference timings
Reject absent, altered, hash-mismatched, internal or unbound trusted admission; head/tree and receipt identity drift
Reject allocation, protocol, runtime/resource, source-manifest and diagnostic source pins drifting from trusted admission
Reject missing or altered parent source/runtime preflight, restored inventory and frozen source bytes
Reject missing/extra/incorrect module path/hash/blob evidence for each cell and absent primary historical module
Reject wrong exact -B -s argv, Python environment, GC, executable or 512MiB address-space evidence
Reject missing supervisor or log, wrong limits/inherited limits, nonzero exit, failed cleanup, output gaps and errors
Reject parent phase resource ceilings, nonmonotonic totals, incomplete allocation/capture gaps and receipt inventory tampering
Reject missing/altered return capture, evaluator identity, complete science/RNG equality and state-boundary evidence
Reject inactive-protection marker absence, U accounting drift, P journal/meter/choice evidence drift and nonpositive/nonfinite timing
Classify fixed literal all-pass ratios at 0.80/0.90 limits after externally pinned custody bytes and exact fresh readback validation
Reject or classify not-material at fixed literal values above either joint threshold with all20 rows retained
Reject forged complete verification object, modified timings, stale evidence or changed trusted admission during timing_report revalidation
Keep classification blocked for absent/untrusted/self-authored custody strings, wrong folder/identity/binding/inventory or changed custody bytes
Reject readback missing/wrong size/hash, bad Drive ID/URL, upload/download event mismatch, nonfresh/reused readback, duplicate IDs and incomplete exact file coverage

data_policy: One explicitly literal invented scientific object and literal RNG states are copied into the finite schedule; no random, generated, fuzzed, real fixture, dataset or actual observation content. Numerical negative variants are enumerated in test parameter lists. Mocks are limited to frozen-source verification if necessary; verification and timing entry points themselves are never mocked.
test_execution: Parent runs the fixed tests only after review of this plan and implementation; this worker does not execute tests.
